_about: Estimated value scores for each rendered draft. These are Claude's estimates from a weighted rubric applied to what each draft contained (its change notes, the keynote audit, the audio measurements), not audience data. Replace them with YouTube analytics (retention, click-through, comments) once the film is published.
method: Each criterion is scored 0 to 10; the total is the weighted sum, out of 100.

criteria.label: Hook
criteria.desc: The first 15 s grab attention and promise value

criteria.label: Clear value
criteria.desc: A clear, useful takeaway the viewer can act on

criteria.label: Plain words
criteria.desc: A mass audience can follow it: jargon explained, text readable

criteria.label: Audio
criteria.desc: Voice, music and sound working together

criteria.label: Pacing
criteria.desc: One idea at a time, enough time to read

criteria.label: Trust
criteria.desc: Honest framing, disclaimer, the professional decides

1.why: First cut from the script: placeholders for footage, draft AI voice, captions, crowded screens.

2.why: Stronger hook ("how a liquidation works in the age of AI"), lever animation; still placeholders and dense text.

3.why: Serious British voice, placeholders removed, disclaimer clearer; jargon (IR35, MCP) unexplained.

4.why: Animated captions help non-native viewers; official Skool logo.

5.why: Faster, livelier voice; IR35 context; shame-to-grace card; BAM effect adds energy.

6.why: Sharp HD visuals, AI core animation, ChatGPT co-pilot and handover graphics; screens getting busier.

7.why: Emojis and the Hero's Journey card add warmth but more text per screen.

9.why: Corrected Scene 7 rule, distinct friend voice, BAM removed: more accurate and calmer.

10.why: Review fixes (centred cards); the audit found all 163 text moments over the keynote limits.

11.why: Keynote cut: one idea per screen and easy to read, but silent gaps (no music), no captions and jargon still unexplained.

12.why: Adds a cinematic music bed and 24 drawn visuals; still a liquidation how-to with unexplained jargon.

13.why: Reframed as transformation and teaching yourself with AI, so it speaks to anyone facing change; every specialist term explained; inspiring piano bed; screens timed to the spoken word. Still an AI voice and no caption file yet.
